messages:
maya: Reposting postmortem follow-ups here for the KV residency/OOM pattern we hit this morning. Goal: capture owners, deadlines, and short vs long-term work. Keep replies short.

liam: Ack. Can you summarize the current mitigation state?

maya: Mitigations applied: soft caps on shards, emergency eviction tweak. Incidents popped at 02:1102:36 UTC. Heap samples show slow steady KV retention increase during quiet minutes; eviction counters low despite active workload. Artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/oom/175612/instances.tar.gz

anita: I ran malloc traces and slab histograms. There's an unusual number of small persistent objects attributed to session-cache buckets. Uploading traces to the above bucket.

zack: Quick plan: 1) add per-shard soft limit + alert (immediate), 2) enable slab debug on two canaries, 3) reproduce with session-reuse harness.

tom: I'll own the eviction tweak PR and add a regression test that simulates low-noise growth over many iterations.

ACTIONS (claim below):
A1) Soft-limit rule + incident playbook update 0% buffer to current peak 0 owner: liam 0 due: today EOD
A2) Canary enable slab debug + full pprof capture 0 owner: zack 0 due: tomorrow 07:00 UTC
A3) Deep malloc_trace analysis and hypothesis write-up 0 owner: anita 0 due: next Tue
A4) Eviction fairness + regression tests 0 owner: tom 0 due: 10 days
A5) Weekly residency drift alert prototype (7d growth detector) 0 owner: liam 0 due: 3 weeks

liam: Will add soft-limit rule and a runbook note for oncall escalation + cooldown to avoid thrash.

anita: Early signal: ChunkRef retain counts increase correlated with archived-request path. Hypothesis: coroutine-local caches not cleared on connection reset.

zack: I can reproduce with the session-reuse test harness. Draft fix to clear coroutine caches on teardown: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/12811 (WIP).

tom: PR for eviction fix coming this afternoon. I'll include a microbenchmark that simulates slow steady growth to catch regressions.

maya: SRE, can you verify the emergency playbook note and mark incident as mitigated once soft caps hold?

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-17561 created; status: acknowledged.

liam: Note: will set soft_limit = max(peak * 0.78, min_threshold) and an alert at 65% that triggers operator review. 5m cooldown on enforcement.

anita: Running an overnight soak on staging with slab_debug; collecting kv.active_refs and kv.eviction_rate metrics.

zack: Canary deploy scheduled 04:00 UTC. If green, roll to the affected shard group by 06:00.

maya: Thanks 50. After fixes land, we need a post-deploy soak + automated test in CI that asserts no retained refs after N session cycles. Who owns CI test?

tom: I'll add the CI job as part of the eviction PR.

maya: Summary: liam = soft-limits & drift detector prototype; zack = canary/debug + deploy; anita = root-cause analysis; tom = eviction + CI tests; maya = postmortem update and follow-up tracker. Update the GH issue with PR links and artifacts. We'll reconvene after the staging soak.

sre-bot: Update: INC-2026-17561 -> mitigated (soft limits active).

maya: Closing loop: please update the GH issue and add any extra artifacts. We'll schedule a 30min sync next Tue to review RCA.
